description: Notebook overview: how many notes exist (by type: file/flow/lesson), how many are flagged stale (their anchored files drifted since verification), and how many are superseded/retracted. Pass `paths` (array of repo-relative paths) to instead list the notes anchored at each of those exact paths with their freshness state — a quick "is anything known here?" check across several files at once.

paths.description: Optional repo-relative paths. When given, returns per-path anchored notes + freshness instead of the whole-notebook overview.

name: kb_status
